pages.name: empty
outline: Other servers running Sentry Six Manager can encode clips for this one. This server reads each clip, sends it to the node over HTTPS and checks the encoded file before it saves anything, as with its own GPUs. Nodes never get your share passwords and never touch the footage.
On the other server, open Nodes → Let another server use this one → Show pairing code.
Let another server use this one
Pair a main server here and it sends this server clips to encode, then takes the encoded files back. It can’t do anything else here: no footage, settings or passwords.
The main server picks which of this server's GPUs (and its CPU) encode, and how many clips each converts at once, in its own Encoder.

pages.name: full
outline: Other servers running Sentry Six Manager can encode clips for this one. This server reads each clip, sends it to the node over HTTPS and checks the encoded file before it saves anything, as with its own GPUs. Nodes never get your share passwords and never touch the footage.
Automatic conversion sends this node these vehicles' new clips first, in this order; with none waiting, it helps the others.
[select Add a vehicle for Garage PC]
Its encodes get the picture check here: a few random stretches of each clip compared with the original. Trust only a computer of your own: it skips that check.
Benchmark, H.265 on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
done · 3 sample clips from your footage, only read (already converted ones: no originals are left)
Use 2 at once on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
None: it helps whichever vehicle is converting.
[select Add a vehicle for Office NAS]
Its encodes replace originals without the picture check (streams, length, frames and telemetry are still verified). Turn off if anyone else could change this computer.
